figures.label: Figure 2
figures.caption:
Effect of chemicals on 2-week-old rice seedlings.
            (A) epi-5DS levels in root exudates of 1 µM chemical-treated rice seedlings determined by LC-MS/MS. The data are means ± SD of three samples. (B) The length of 2nd leaf sheath in 10 µM chemical-treated rice. The data are means ± SD of six samples.

figures.label: Figure 4
figures.caption:
Effects of TIS108 on 2-week-old rice seedlings.
            (A) epi-5DS levels in roots and root exudates of TIS108-treated rice seedlings determined by LC-MS/MS. (B) Germination stimulant levels in culture media of 1 µM TIS108-treated rice seedlings using Striga seeds. DW, distilled water; GR24, 1 µM GR24; control, non-treated rice culture media; TIS108, culture media of 1 µM TIS108-treated rice; TIS108+GR24, culture media coincubated with 1 µM GR24 and 1 µM TIS108. The data are means ± SD of three samples.
